propositions: Gateway providers (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) are incorrectly stamped as tier first_class despite requests transiting through intermediaries that can rewrite them.
Tier derivation in capabilities.py considers only base_url presence, not whether the provider name indicates a gateway route.
Signed verdicts with misrepresented provenance tier undermines attestation consumer trust in two-tier design.
Gateway providers without explicit base_url should be marked tier best_effort to accurately reflect that an opaque intermediary can modify request/response.
endpoint_host remains None for gateway providers unless base_url is explicitly configured, reflecting only what was actually set rather than synthesized hostnames.
